snippet.title: Flashpoint Campaigns: Cold War - Lowland Lions | Out Now
snippet.description:
We are excited to announce that Flashpoint Campaigns: Cold War - Lowland Lions is out now.
The Northern Sector of the Inter-German border comes to life as you take command of the Dutch 1st Corps, featuring specialized ground search radar, water-heavy high-speed corridors, and 14 scenarios including the classic Wolves Campaign from Red Storm.

🎮 Buy the game on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4758460/Flashpoint_Campaigns_Cold_War__Lowland_Lions/?l
Ⓜ️ More info on Matrix ➡️ https://www.matrixgames.com/game/flashpoint-campaigns-cold-war-lowland-lions
